rule.statement: A person who possesses a land with honest belief that they are the owner and without any dispute for a period of 23 years can be considered to have acquired prescriptive title to the land.
rule.supporting_quote: For the above reasons, I hold that the Plaintiff-Respondent has proved undisturbed, uninterrupted and adverse possession for a period of 23 years; that he has proved the necessary ingredients set out in Section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance and that the Plaintiff-Respondent is entitled to succeed in this case.
